summary.headline: Strong week: orders 817 and revenue $62,651 both beat weekly targets, but the quarter remains behind at 90% of target with four weeks left.

points.what: Revenue reached $62,651, up 17.4% on last week and up 64.7% year on year, against an 8-week average of $51,914.
points.so_what: The week landed 108.7% of its revenue target, $5,031 above it.

points.what: Orders came in at 817, up 3.5% week on week and outside the 8-week range, versus an 8-week average of 716.
points.so_what: That is 101.2% of the weekly orders target, 10 orders ahead.

points.what: Quarter-to-date revenue is $477,960 against a target to date of $531,360, an attainment of 90.0%.
points.so_what: Reaching the full quarter target of $774,555 requires $296,595 across the remaining four weeks.

points.what: The cancellation rate fell 4.7 pp to 14.3% while new signups fell 10.8% to 256.
points.so_what: Order quality improved this week, but customer acquisition moved the other way.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate is only reported for the mature week of 09 Feb 2026, as the two most recent weeks are not yet mature.
points.so_what: Return behaviour for the reporting week cannot be read yet, so the 10.8% figure describes 09 Feb 2026 only.

points.what: Revenue growth of 64.7% and orders growth of 62.1% year on year are both below the 75% growth the targets assume.
points.so_what: At this pace the gap to target builds even in weeks that beat their own weekly target.

points.what: Both completed months are behind target: Jan at 88.0% and Feb at 92.4%, short by $35,226 and $18,174.
points.so_what: The QTD shortfall of $53,400 reflects two full months below target, not a single weak week.

points.what: Weekly orders hit 101.2% of target at 817 versus 807, and weekly revenue hit 108.7% at $62,651 versus $57,620.
points.so_what: Both weekly targets were beaten, with next week's bar set at 838 orders and $58,985 of revenue.

points.what: QTD revenue is behind at 90.0% of target, $53,400 short, with four weeks left in 2026-Q1.
points.so_what: One strong week has not closed the quarter gap; $296,595 is still needed for the full quarter target.

points.what: YTD revenue is behind at 90.0% of target, leaving $3,410,842 of the $3,888,802 full-year target over 44 weeks, a required $77,519 per week.
points.so_what: The recent 8-week run-rate of $53,830 is well below that required pace.

points.what: LATAM orders rose 25.2% to 134, contributing 27 of the 28 additional orders, or 96.4% of the week's change.
points.so_what: The week's order growth came almost entirely from the smallest region, at 16.4% of orders.

points.what: Search orders rose 4.7% to 575, contributing 26 orders or 92.9% of the change, while Organic added 21 orders.
points.so_what: Search, at 70.4% of orders, carried the increase and remains the source the weekly total depends on.

points.what: Facebook orders fell 27.3% to 48, a drag of 18 orders, and EMEA fell 4.9% to 156, a drag of 8 orders.
points.so_what: These declines offset part of the gains, holding net order growth to 3.5%.

points.what: AOV rose 7.2% week on week to $89.50 but is down 1.2% against $90.55 a year ago.
points.so_what: Revenue grew faster than orders this week, though basket value is still slightly below last year's level.

points.what: The cancellation rate fell 4.7 pp to 14.3%, down from 19.0% and below last year's 16.7%.
points.so_what: Each percentage point of cancellations is worth about $731 of revenue, so the improvement supports the week's revenue beat.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate for the mature week of 09 Feb 2026 was flat at 10.8%, but 1.5 pp above last year's 9.3%.
points.so_what: Return behaviour is stable week to week yet running worse than a year ago.

points.what: New signups fell 10.8% to 256 while orders rose 3.5%; year on year signups are up 9.9% against orders up 62.1%.
points.so_what: Order growth is far outpacing new customer growth, so the week leaned on the existing customer base.

anomaly flag acknowledged in the summary
sentences at most 30 words and 4 numbers
each slot only covers its allowed KPIs
